title: Insulated oil line heat loss
line: A steady conjugate heat transfer FEA study of hot oil in a lagged steel pipe losing heat to still air.
description: Engine oil at 127 C flowing in a 1 in schedule 40 steel pipe with 25 mm of glass-fiber lagging, cooled outside by natural convection and radiation to 25 C. The study returns the jacket surface temperature and the heat lost; the radial resistance network gives 28 W/m and a 36 C surface.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature through the lagging of a hot-oil line, solved in RunMat
